title: ModelCatalogueItem
description: A provider model the company may use (PRD section 5, FR-601). Aliases can target it only once a privacy officer approves it, and any change to it needs approval again.

provider.description: For example anthropic, google, openai, mistral.

region.description: Where the provider processes requests, for example eu-west-1.

termsRef.description: Reference to the reviewed provider terms.

dpaRef.description: Reference to the data processing agreement (GDPR Art 28).

aiActProviderStatus.description: The provider's status under the EU AI Act, for example gpai-provider.

priceSheet.title: ModelPriceSheet
priceSheet.description: Provider list prices, passed through at cost (invariant 7).
